scope: The reviewed connection clean-up switch of the staging connector (v1 PR 5, docs/briefs/v1-connection-health.md; ADR-0025 item 10, ADR-0031 item 3). Committed off: the connector's five-minute cron runs only the M2 PR-3 re-drives (received deliveries, undestroyed tokens of ended installations, the privacy deadline check) and the reconcile of open Reconnect items; it never asks the broker to read an installation's scopes back from Shopify, never deletes an uninstalled store's data itself and never closes a stuck delivery. A scope change still keeps the connection and its token (the delivery's scopes only narrow), and a reinstall still works, whatever the switch. It is turned on only by one reviewed commit that sets switch to on and adds MORROW_CONNECTION_CLEANUP "on" to the staging connector's vars: from then on the cron reads each live installation's granted scopes with its own token once a day (a read of the owner's store under ADR-0035 item 4), deletes the data of an installation uninstalled 48 hours ago whose shop/redact never completed (once, with its record; ADR-0031 item 3, which the owner approved), and closes scope-change deliveries stuck for 24 hours. edge:check refuses any mixed state; production has no switch until the ADR-0007 item 9 custody ADR.
